name: unscraped
description: Find Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitors, PodMonitors and PrometheusRules that Prometheus silently ignores or that find no target: a missing release label, a namespace Prometheus doesn't watch, a port name that isn't on the Service or pod, a selector that matches pod labels instead of Service labels, and timeouts the operator rejects. Reads manifests and helm template output, never a cluster.
